messages:
Jordan Lee: Hey folks day 2 question: where's the right place to post different onboarding issues? VPN, laptop requests, repo access. Also saw a bunch of bots which ones can I poke?
Priya Menon: Welcome Jordan! Super short map: hardware & HR -> #people-ops (use pinned request form). VPN & infra access -> #eng-infra. Repo/github access -> open SSO access in #help and include your GitHub handle.
Lucas Grant: If you're blocked (no VPN or can't clone), post in #help and @eng-oncall if it's urgent. That channel gets triaged faster than DMs.
Jordan Lee: Nice. And bots? I want to try Onboarding Bot but not break anything.
Onboarding Bot: Hi Jordan! You can safely DM me or run `/onboard me` to get your checklist. I only DM when you trigger me or your manager enrolls you.
Priya Menon: We keep a small #devex-sandbox for trying slash commands and dev bots. Avoid running unknown deploy/infra commands in public channels.
IT Help Bot: For hardware swaps or shipping, file at https://peopleops.internal/tickets and include manager & shipping address. For urgent hardware mark the ticket "priority".
Lucas Grant: Etiquette TL;DR: 1) Search channel history & handbook first. 2) Pick the most specific channel. 3) Use threads to keep the channel tidy. 4) Paste short logs in fenced code blocks, long traces -> unlisted gist. 5) Never paste secrets; rotate immediately if leaked and notify #eng-security.
Jordan Lee: If I accidentally post a secret, what's the exact flow?
Priya Menon: Delete the message, rotate the credential, then ping #eng-security. There's a secrets-runbook pinned there with steps.
Jordan Lee: Great, I'll use #help for blocking stuff and #devex-sandbox for bot tests. Thanks! :tada:
